svg.title: Channels represented over time
svg.desc: Monthly counts in the recovered sample only, not total posting activity. Unrequested months break the line. Hollow markers identify partial requested months.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Channels with recovered posts per month
Source: recovered-corpus metadata. Uneven recovery is not a posting-activity trend. Zero means no
recovered posts, not inactivity. Channels are distinct accounts, not publishers. * Hollow markers and
dashed segments: partial requested months; no extrapolation. Requested window ends 24 Oct 2026.
